title: Info panel: show real pixel W/H for all selected object types (symbols, shapes, text); add stage cursor X/Y to StatusBar
description:
## Problem
Flash 8's Info panel (Ctrl+I) is a live readout of the selected object's X/Y position and W/H bounding box. Our current implementation (Shell.tsx line 4043–4081) is a static inline block that:
- Shows W/H only for bitmap-type DisplayObjects (hardcoded `type === 'bitmap'` check)
- Shows '—' for W/H of symbol instances, shapes, and text fields
- Does not update W/H when the selection changes to a non-bitmap object

Additionally, Flash 8's status bar shows the current stage-space cursor coordinates (X/Y) in the bottom-left corner. Our StatusBar component has no cursor position prop.

## What's needed

### 1. Extract a bounding-box helper
Add a `getDisplayObjectBounds(obj: DisplayObject, doc: FlashDocument): { w: number, h: number } | null` utility in packages/core/src/model or packages/authoring-ui/src/. Logic per type:
- **bitmap**: existing path — use `(obj.width ?? 0) * (obj.scaleX ?? 1)` etc.
- **instance (symbol)**: look up the Symbol in doc.library.items; compute natural size from the symbol's first-frame displayObjects' bounding extents, then apply instance scaleX/scaleY. For a first pass, looking up a cached 'naturalSize' (width/height) from the library item's own bounding annotation is acceptable; alternatively compute from shape paths.
- **shape**: compute path bounding box from obj.shape.paths segments (iterate all points, min/max X/Y).
- **text**: use obj.width (TextField width) × obj.height if present; fall back to estimated advance × line count from font metrics.

### 2. Upgrade the Info panel
Replace the hardcoded bitmap-only logic with the new helper. Show W/H for all object types. Extract this into a proper `InfoPanel` component (packages/authoring-ui/src/InfoPanel.tsx) matching Flash 8's two-column X/Y/W/H layout with numeric input fields that update position/size when edited.

### 3. Add cursor position to StatusBar
- Add `cursorPos?: { x: number; y: number } | null` prop to StatusBarProps (StatusBar.tsx).
- Display 'X: 123  Y: 456' in the status bar when cursorPos is non-null.
- In StageArea.tsx, pass stage-space mouse coordinates up via an `onCursorMove` callback on each mousemove event.
- Wire Shell.tsx: track cursorPos state, pass to StatusBar.

## Acceptance criteria
- Selecting a SymbolInstance on stage shows non-dash W/H in the Info panel.
- Selecting a Shape object shows W/H derived from path bounding extents.
- Selecting a text field shows W/H.
- Moving the cursor over the stage updates the status bar X/Y readout in stage coordinates (px, not screen px).
- Unit tests for the bounding-box helper covering bitmap, shape, and text cases.

## References
- packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx (inline Info section, line 4043–4081)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StatusBar.tsx (no cursorPos prop)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx (cursorPos tracked internally in penState, line 947/1967; mousemove handler line 1820)
